title: A table that foreign key actions change can't be append-only
symptom: cdc-table-plan chose append for a log-like table that ON DELETE CASCADE also deletes from
cause: Append keeps rows as inserted; a delete from a foreign key action has nowhere to go
effect: The appended table keeps rows the source deleted
fix: cdc-table-plan gives tables with an acting foreign key SCD type 1, and plan.py warns on append
